name: Find the Path

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: a set of divination tools, such as cards or runes, worth 100+ GP

summary: Always know the shortest direct route to a fixed place you've been to before on the same plane.
text: You also know how far away it is and, when you face a choice of paths, which way to go. It fails on a destination that moves or that you don't know well enough.
